thePartsMicmaneIsBuiltFromSetThe: The parts MicMane is built from, set the way the product sets them: white booklet pages on paper, ink type, one colour per foundation, graphite sleeves, and orange glass for whatever is live.
everyNoteEndsWithOneThingToTry: Every note ends with one thing to try on the next take.
addTheDomainForExampleYouExampleCom: Add the domain, for example you@example.com.
forThreeYearsIRanTheNightShift: For three years, I ran the night shift…
allFiveFoundationsReviewedTwoNotesOnPace: All five foundations reviewed: two notes on pace, two on pauses, one on volume, one on tonality.
silenceBetweenTwoLinesInSeconds: Silence between two lines, in seconds
tentativeNotesAreJudgmentCallsOtherReadi: Tentative notes are judgment calls. Other readings could work too.
theRecordingAndItsReviewWillBeGone: The recording and its review will be gone. MicMane doesn't keep a copy.
eachNoteIsPinnedToTheSecondIt: Each note is pinned to the second it refers to.
takesOverAMinuteAreTrimmed: Takes over a minute are trimmed
theCoachReviewsTheMiddleMinuteTimestamps: The coach reviews the middle minute. Timestamps refer to that excerpt.
theCoachIsBusyRightNow: The coach is busy right now
waitAMinuteAndSendTheTakeAgain: Wait a minute and send the take again.
allowTheMicrophoneForThisSiteInYour: Allow the microphone for this site in your browser's settings.
noYouGetNotesOnMomentsInYour: No. You get notes on moments in your take, each with something to try next.
noItIsSentToDeepgramAndMistral: No. It is sent to Deepgram and Mistral for the review and not kept by MicMane.
englishWithOneSpeakerForNow: English, with one speaker, for now.
aNearWhiteCanvasAndGraphiteInksEach: A near-white canvas and graphite inks. Each foundation is a pair: pastel for fields, deep ink for text. Orange glass is the one warm light, for play controls and whatever is live.
archivoStretchedTwoWaysWideAndExtraBold: Archivo stretched two ways: wide and extra-bold for anything that names a thing, normal width for reading. Martian Mono numbers the take and the label.
placeholderUntilTheMarkIsDesignedAMicrop: Placeholder until the mark is designed: a microphone wearing a mane in the five foundation inks.
drawnFromTheTakeOneRidgeForEach: Drawn from the take: one ridge for each line that showed a strength, filled with that foundation and stacked up from the bottom. Few strengths make a low stack; covers fill up as you practise. The promotional sleeve shows every foundation.
aTakeReadAsItsLyricsTimecodesIn: A take read as its lyrics: timecodes in the gutter, noted words under a foundation highlighter, notes beneath the line. Silence between lines becomes space.
sitsUnderTheLineItIsAboutAnd: Sits under the line it is about and quotes its words in the same highlighter: foundation and rule, why it matters, and one thing to try. Every note and every phrase in it can be played.
forThreeYearsIRanTheNightShift2: For three years, I ran the night shift
oneMinuteOfTapeLeftToRightIt: One minute of tape, left to right. It fills with your level as you speak; what is left is a bare line, waiting.
stateIsDrawnWithStrokeNeverColourFilled: State is drawn with stroke, never colour: filled is a strength, an open ring is an improvement, dashed means tentative.
inkForThePrimaryActionOrangeGlassFor: Ink for the primary action. Orange glass for play controls and recording. Graphite is the sleeve's colour.
squareShoulderedTagsNeverPillsFoundation: Square-shouldered tags, never pills. Foundations carry their fill with ink text; illustrated data is labelled with a dashed edge.
glassInkFocusErrorsNameTheProblemAnd: Glass-ink focus. Errors name the problem and the fix.
segmentedOnSunkenGroundOrASinglePixel: Segmented on sunken ground, or a single-pixel line.
layerSwitchesKeepTheLabelInkOnlyThe: Layer switches keep the label ink; only the swatch carries colour, and it dims when off.
theSliderIsThePlayheadAOnePixel: The slider is the playhead: a one-pixel ruler and an orange glass handle.
hairlineBorderBarelyLiftedNeverNested: Hairline border, barely lifted. Never nested.
inkOnWhiteUsedForMeasuredValuesAnd: Ink on white, used for measured values and terms.
onlyWhereFocusMustBeProtectedSuchAs: Only where focus must be protected, such as discarding a take.
onPhonesNotesAndNavigationArriveFromThe: On phones, notes and navigation arrive from the edge.
aGlassBeadFillingASunkenTrackFor: A glass bead filling a sunken track, for work that takes a while.
hairlineForInformationTintedForErrorsGra: Hairline for information, tinted for errors, graphite on dark ground.
holdsTheReviewSShapeWhileItLoads: Holds the review's shape while it loads: a timecode and a line.
rowsAndSectionsSeparateBySpacingALine: Rows and sections separate by spacing. A line marks a pane split or a scroll edge; a free-standing separator fades out at both ends.
